title: Database disk full
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the PostgreSQL storage as the broken part, the disk‑full problem, and the nightly backup job as the trigger.
root_cause: The nightly pg_dump backup job writes large dump files into the PostgreSQL storage volume, filling it to 100% and causing PostgreSQL to return 'No space left on device' errors, which the API surfaces as 500 errors on order placement.
truth: The disk /var/lib/postgresql is 100% full because the new nightly backup job saves its dumps on the same disk, so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
